title: Break the calibration gauge with independent capacities and two real Laplace points
statement: Known positive diagonal C and two s2>s1>0 give B_j=H^-1/2(K+s_j C)H^-1/2 from calibrated-command tomography. Then h_i=(s2-s1)C_i/[B2(ii)-B1(ii)] and K=H^1/2 B1 H^1/2-s1 C. If C is unknown, only C_i/h_i is identified.

requires: Known node count/labels and calibrated positive shunts for finite tomography; exact responses and connected SPD M-matrix. Self-calibration additionally needs independent absolute capacities, common known source/port calibration, h_0=1 and exact positive-real Laplace responses. These are not two sinusoidal frequencies.
provides: Known positive diagonal C and two s2>s1>0 give B_j=H^-1/2(K+s_j C)H^-1/2 from calibrated-command tomography. Then h_i=(s2-s1)C_i/[B2(ii)-B1(ii)] and K=H^1/2 B1 H^1/2-s1 C. If C is unknown, only C_i/h_i is identified.
assumptions: Exact real identifiability/count optimality does not imply robust physical recovery. Positive diagonal shunts cannot remove the hidden-loss depth barrier under the specified readout model. The stronger transient all-signed-input bound charges squared input, not physical work. Unequal-variance extension compares Gaussian KL, not Blackwell order. All8 noisy direct calibrations rejected or left the physical class; ordinary constrained joint fitting was stronger but small port error did not identify internal parameters. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: Pay interventions, calibration, settling, finite pulse tail and reset cycles. Tail bias <=Q exp(-sT)/(s C_0 U(s)), variance sigma²(1-exp(-2sT))/(2s U(s)²); longer horizon leaves nonzero noise variance. Inverse conditioning/depth can amplify tiny errors. Full waveforms may be more informative than two summaries.
contract.units: K and shunts are conductances; C capacity; s inverse time; response inverse conductance. Squared input integral is not automatically dissipated energy.
contract.obstruction: Acquire calibrated internal access or independent capacities and useful parameter-error bounds; validate noise/reset/physical work and compare full-data incumbents before claiming specimen identification.

body: Apply the finite single-port construction separately at two real Laplace points. Their diagonal slope is C_i/h_i, breaking the old congruence gauge only because C is independently known. A finite rectangular pulse approximates each response with the explicit exponential tail and white-noise variance in the parent. Taking T large reduces tail but does not eliminate variance or inverse conditioning. The completed audit checked exact calibrations and retained0/8 physically valid noisy direct returns. This is a conditional reconstruction, not self-created absolute calibration.
